intro.title: About
intro.subtitle: Discover everything that shapes Ingeri's deep identity.

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.body: To prepare a generation of servant leaders, called to grow with a character rooted in wisdom, service and empathy, guided by integrity and capable of positively transforming the world around them. We aspire to become a leading network of schools, known for academic excellence and strong Christian values.

vision.heading: Our vision
vision.body: To sow the seeds of excellence from early childhood, by offering quality education rooted in Christian values. From the earliest stages of a child's life, we provide learning adapted to each child's own pace, stimulating their curiosity, creativity and social interactions. We support each child's holistic development : spiritual, emotional, intellectual, social and physical in a safe, loving and stimulating environment.

campus.title: Our
campus.subtitle: Two campuses, one philosophy: to provide a safe, loving and stimulating environment for your child.

creche.name: La P'tite Crèche Ingeri
creche.message: A loving and nurturing space for little ones, where children feel safe, grow in confidence, develop independence, and discover at their own pace.
creche.address: KK 389 St Kagarama, Kicukiro, Kigali, Rwanda

maternelle.name: Ingeri International School
maternelle.message: A French-speaking preschool where educational excellence meets a nurturing environment, empowering every child to thrive.

items.title: Growing with Confidence
items.desc: Each child develops their potential in a safe and nurturing environment where they learn, explore, and thrive at their own pace.

items.title: Growing with values
items.desc: We nurture love, respect, kindness, sharing, and gratitude through an education inspired by Christian values.

items.title: Growing open to the world
items.desc: We encourage children to discover the richness of different cultures, explore the world around them, and embrace others with kindness, love, and respect.

items.title: Growing together
items.desc: We build a trusting partnership with families to support each child’s development and overall well-being.

items.title: Child-centred
items.desc: Every child is unique. The adult observes, encourages and supports without imposing.

items.title: Christian foundation
items.desc: Patience, respect, humility, joy and forgiveness at the heart of every day.

items.title: The bond
items.desc: Child–educator, child–family: shared trust creates security.

items.title: Connection to nature
items.desc: Gardening, natural objects: nature nurtures wonder.

items.title: Autonomy and dignity
items.desc: The child learns to 'do it alone' and to trust themselves.

domaines.title: Our
domaines.subtitle: At Ingeri, we support each child according to their age, pace, and individual needs. Our program combines structured learning, hands-on experiences, and moments of exploration to nurture the child's overall development.

items.title: Sensory and motor awakening:
items.desc: Exploration through the senses, movement, manipulation, and discovery of the environment.

items.title: Language development:
items.desc: Conversation, stories, songs, and daily interactions to enrich communication.

items.title: Growing independence:
items.desc: Supporting the child in their first steps toward independence, at their own pace.

items.title: Emotional and social development:
items.desc: Creating a secure setting where the child learns to express emotions and interact with others.

items.title: Spiritual awakening:
items.desc: Discovering Christian values through songs, prayers, and moments suited to young children.

items.title: Early academic learning:
items.desc: language, pre-reading, writing, mathematics, discovery of the world, and first scientific concepts.

items.title: Creativity and expression:
items.desc: artistic activities, music, physical expression, and creative projects.

items.title: Thinking and curiosity:
items.desc: observation, experimentation, problem-solving, and learning through play.

items.title: Social skills:
items.desc: cooperation, communication, self-confidence, and group life.

items.title: Cultural and spiritual openness:
items.desc: discovering the world, cultures, and Christian values.

domaines.pedagogyTitle: An active pedagogy centered on every child
domaines.pedagogyBody: Inspired by active learning pedagogies, our approach puts the child at the center of their own learning. We create an environment where every child can explore, experiment, create, and grow with confidence.

items.title: Language & Expression
items.desc: Stories, songs, prayers, and guided conversations.

items.title: Logic & First Numbers
items.desc: Objects, shapes, and quantities to discover the order of the world.

items.title: Creativity & Meaning
items.desc: Painting, singing, modelling, dance.

items.title: Practical Life & Autonomy
items.desc: Getting dressed, tidying up, serving, taking care of oneself and others.

items.title: Spiritual Awakening & Values
items.desc: Prayers, Bible stories, songs, gratitude, and respect for others.
